name: osc1_type
help: oscillator 1 waveform engine (classic, wavetable, FM, string, noise…)

name: osc1_octave
help: oscillator 1 octave shift

name: osc1_pitch
help: oscillator 1 fine pitch in semitones

name: osc1_shape
help: oscillator 1 waveform shape: changes tone colour

name: osc1_sub
help: oscillator 1 sub-octave mix: adds weight below

name: osc1_unison_voices
help: oscillator 1 stacked voices: more = thicker, wider

name: osc1_unison_detune
help: oscillator 1 detune between stacked voices: more = wobblier, chorus-like

name: osc1_level
help: oscillator 1 level in the mix

name: osc2_type
help: oscillator 2 waveform engine

name: osc2_octave
help: oscillator 2 octave shift

name: osc2_pitch
help: oscillator 2 fine pitch in semitones (detune against osc 1)

name: osc2_shape
help: oscillator 2 waveform shape

name: osc2_level
help: oscillator 2 level in the mix

name: noise_level
help: noise level: breath, air, hiss, snare-like texture

name: noise_color
help: noise colour: lower = darker rumble, higher = brighter hiss

name: filter_type
help: main filter type (low-pass, band-pass, high-pass, comb…)

name: filter_cutoff
help: brightness: lower = darker, more muffled

name: filter_resonance
help: emphasis at the cutoff: more = sharper, whistling, acid

name: filter_env_amount
help: how much the filter envelope opens the filter: the 'pluck' or 'wow'

name: filter_keytrack
help: how much brightness follows the note pitch

name: highpass
help: removes low end: higher = thinner

name: amp_attack
help: fade-in time: 0 = instant hit, longer = swell

name: amp_decay
help: time to fall from the peak to the sustain level

name: amp_sustain
help: level held while the key is down: 0 = percussive

name: amp_release
help: tail after the key is released

name: filter_env_attack
help: filter envelope attack time

name: filter_env_decay
help: filter envelope decay time: short = plucky

name: filter_env_sustain
help: filter envelope sustain level

name: filter_env_release
help: filter envelope release time

name: lfo1_rate
help: speed of LFO 1 movement (wobble, vibrato)

name: lfo1_amount
help: depth of LFO 1 movement

name: drive
help: saturation/distortion amount: grit and warmth

name: shaper_type
help: saturation flavour (soft, hard, asymmetric, fold…)

name: feedback
help: filter feedback: thick, aggressive, unstable at high values

name: drift
help: slow random pitch drift: analog/tape instability

name: play_mode
help: poly, mono or legato playing

name: glide
help: pitch glide time between notes

name: volume
help: overall level of the sound
